shared_elements: schematic human head carved in the round
large emphasized eyes set beneath heavy brow ridges
brow ridges rendered as a continuous raised arc/band over the eyes
vertical ridge forming the nose continuous with the brows
columnar neck/body support beneath the head
justification: Both depict a highly schematic anthropomorphic head in the round with oversized, bulging eyes set under a single continuous raised brow ridge that runs into a vertical nose ridge, the head rising from a plain columnar neck/shaft with no other iconography — a distinctive and specific shared scheme. The main differences are that A is seen frontally at close range with the mouth/lower face barely indicated (a small knob below) while B shows a fully articulated lower face with modelled nose and mouth and a more elongated, slender head, making B somewhat more naturalistic in proportion.
